docs.title: About
docs.text: ## A shop by the sea GAYA sits on Had Lamai Road, a few steps from the water on the east coast of Koh Samui. It started as a small stall and grew into the shop it is today — still run by the same hands, still filled with things we would wear ourselves. We sell what the island gives us: light cotton and hemp, hand-dyed indigo, embroidery from hill-tribe makers, and the fisherman pants that started it all. ## Made to travel light The fisherman pants are the reason most people find us.
